nodes.note: A walled churchyard under open sky: the lychgate in the south wall, a flagstone path straight up to the chapel door, leaning headstones on either side and an old yew in the north-east corner.

stations.note: Under the old yew in the yard's north-east corner, among the oldest stones, facing back across the yard.

nodes.note: A small stone chapel, one nave under a pitched roof: a door in the south front, two rows of pews, and the bell standing on its frame on the altar step at the north end.

stations.note: The passing bell, on its floor frame on the altar step at the north end of the nave.
Just inside the door, on the nave floor, where a body coming in from the yard first stands under the roof.
